items.quote: But Moses’ hands were heavy; and they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat thereon;
items.claim: The text says Moses' hands grew heavy, so a stone was put under him and he sat on it.
items.action: sat on a stone placed under him
items.mechanism: His hands were tired, so they gave him something to sit on to hold the position

items.quote: and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side;
items.claim: The text says Aaron and Hur held up Moses' hands, one on each side.
items.mechanism: Two people physically held his arms up from either side

items.quote: and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.
items.claim: The text says that with this support, Moses' hands stayed steady until sunset.
items.mechanism: The stone seat and the two helpers let him keep his hands up
